mapper.sql: select id, name,version, college_id, major_id,category_Id, create_time, creator, last_modified_time, last_modifier, remark, sysflag,status from t_csys_source_domain
mapper.select: select domain.id, domain.name, domain.college_id, domain.major_id,domain.version, domain.create_time, domain.creator, domain.last_modified_time, domain.last_modifier, domain.remark, domain.sysflag,domain.status, unit.name unit_name,point.name point_name,unit.id unit_id,point.id point_id,domain.source_id source_id from t_csys_source_domain domain left join t_csys_source_domain_ref_unit domain_ref_unit on domain.id = domain_ref_unit.domain_id left join t_csys_source_unit unit on domain_ref_unit.unit_id = unit.id left join t_csys_source_unit_ref_point unit_ref_point on unit_ref_point.unit_id = unit.id left join t_csys_source_point point on unit_ref_point.point_id = point.id where domain.id = #{id}

select domain.id, domain.name, domain.college_id, domain.major_id,domain.version, domain.create_time, domain.creator, domain.last_modified_time, domain.last_modifier, domain.remark, domain.sysflag,domain.status, unit.name unit_name,point.name point_name,unit.id unit_id,point.id point_id from t_csys_course_ref_source_domain course_ref_domain left join t_csys_source_domain domain on course_ref_domain.domain_id = domain.id left join t_csys_source_domain_ref_unit domain_ref_unit on domain.id = domain_ref_unit.domain_id left join t_csys_source_unit unit on domain_ref_unit.unit_id = unit.id left join t_csys_source_unit_ref_point unit_ref_point on unit_ref_point.unit_id = unit.id left join t_csys_source_point point on unit_ref_point.point_id = point.id
and course_ref_domain.course_id = #{courseId}
